fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (34.6332,-93.0672) landed in woods east of the plant. Web search + satellite resolved the EXISTING Mountain Valley Spring Water / BlueTriton (Primo Brands) bottling plant at 283 Mountain Valley Water Pl, Hot Springs Village AR 71909. NOTE: this is the legacy plant, not the new ~200k sqft Primo factory that broke ground Oct 2025 on Glazypeau Rd (operational spring 2026); the new factory has no usable imagery yet, so the audit is of the active legacy plant.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at any property entrance. The single private access drive winds ~0.4km through forest from the NE/N to the yard with no checkpoint structure on the imagery. Marked false but low confidence: a gate could sit further up the private drive outside the captured frames. No Street View coverage anywhere within 400m to confirm.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at the yard entrance. False.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because no truck gate is confirmed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: SW building SE/south face: a clear continuous bank of ~14-16 dock bays with flatbeds/box trailers backed in, numbered apron bays visible (z20 s02-z20-swsouth*.png). NE building has a smaller dock/load cluster (~6-8 doors) near the process-tank yard on its south face. Total honest estimate ~22; sits on the 10-25/25-50 band boundary -> banded 10-25 conservatively.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop lot at the SW tip of the property: diagonal rows of parked trailers without tractors (~16-20 visible across two rows). Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropYard: True - the SW lot is a distinct trailer-storage area separate from the active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on two different buildings/faces (SW building south face + NE building south face) suggest split ship/receive, but cannot confirm function from imagery - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved apron between the two buildings and in front of the SW dock bank acts as an internal queue/staging area inside the property.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private approach drive (~0.4km) from the public road plus a deep internal yard -> easily holds 3+ trucks queued before docks.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~14 at SW docks + ~4 at NE docks/process area + ~18 in the SW drop yard + scattered ~2 = ~38. Mixed imagery vintages across tiles; count is approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Drop-yard rows hold ~30-40; additional yard apron space pushes practical capacity to ~50.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~17.5 acres of cleared/paved footprint inside the treeline, derived from the perimeter polygon; the surrounding spring property is far larger but is forest, not yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; nearest infrastructure is the private road only. False.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is deep in forested hills west of Hot Springs Village with no adjacent development -> likely weak cellular coverage. Inferred, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Two capture vintages overlap the site; the SW dock/yard tiles are a newer, lower-contrast set while the NE/entrance tiles are sharper Maxar. Dock counts read best from z18 west crop and z20 SW-south crops.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two primary connected industrial buildings (NE bottling/warehouse + SW warehouse/load building) plus minor process/utility structures counted as one complex -> 2.
